facts.title: Relume — AI Website Builder for Marketing Websites
facts.description: Relume's AI website builder: build on the components behind 2M+ websites, publish in Relume or export to Webflow, Figma & React. Free to start.

research.name: Relume
research.note: AI website builder for marketing sites that generates sitemaps, wireframes and designs from a component library and exports to Webflow, Figma and React.
unverified: The demo seen was the homepage with product screenshots; the builder itself was not run because it needs an account.
